## E — Market signal: speed, passing, right-of-way, intersections, highways and turns
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (NJ-ROAD-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: speed limits, crosswalk stops and right-of-way scenarios are the rules learners most often confuse, which suggests a scenario-drill angle to test later.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.
